title: What is an AI agent? A plain definition | 50agents
description: An AI agent is software with a goal, instructions and tools that decides on each run which steps to take. A plain definition and a real example.
definition: An AI agent is software that is given a goal, instructions and access to tools, and decides on each run which steps to take to reach that goal.
Where a fixed automation does the same thing every time, an AI agent reads the situation first and chooses: which email needs a reply, which deal has gone quiet, what the reply should say.

example.ask: Set up an AI agent that finds my HubSpot deals with no reply in 5 days every weekday at 9:00 and drafts a follow-up email for me to approve
example.why: Each weekday it decides which deals have really gone quiet and what to say to each. That choice on every run is what makes it an AI agent.
